entities.summary: Qudrat Ullah Shahab was a political leaders in Gilgit (1917-02-26, Gilgit – 1986-07-24), a notable figure of the Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
